buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 3. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 4. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and

Commissioning of Goods 5. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 6. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of EXECUTIVE OFFICER payable at NAGAR PANCHAYAT, SINGHESHWAR . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 8. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TENDER SPECIFIC DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FROM BIDDERS : * **All-Inclusive Pricing:** Quoted rates for vehicle supply and custom body fabrication must be comprehe nsively inclusive of **GST**, custom duties, local freight, transit insurance, packing and forwarding, loadin g/unloading, structural design approvals, and all allied fabrication charges. **Zero additional claims** will be entertained. * **Statutory Deductions:** Applicable **Income Tax TDS** and **GST TDS** will be deducted at source fr om running or final bill amounts per the Income Tax Act and GST Act. * **Price Lock Clause:** **No upward rate revision or escalation** is permitted during the supply order curr ency, contract period, or any granted extension period. * **Conditional Offers:** Conditional tenders, optional variants, or bids with counter-conditions will be **rej ected summarily** without evaluation. * **Financial Bid Evaluation:** Financial bids will be opened and evaluated **only for firms qualified and sh ortlisted** during Technical Bid evaluation. * **Right to Cancel:** The Buyer Organization holds the absolute right to cancel, annul, or modify the biddi ng process or tender at any stage without assigning reasons. Bidders must submit a signed and stamped * *acceptance declaration on company letterhead**. **4. Technical Eligibility & Mandatory Document Submissions** *(Note: Omission of any self-attested document in the Technical Bid envelope results in immediate rejectio

n)* * **Legal Entity Registration:** Must be legally registered in India for a **minimum of 3 years**. Submit a valid Registration/Incorporation Certificate. * **Tax Identifications:** Submit self-attested copies of **GST Registration Certificate**, **PAN**, and ** Firm Registration Certificate** (Shop & Establishment or Company Incorporation Certificate). * **Bid Security Declaration:** Submit **Annexure-I** accepting suspension from future bids for the sp ecified timeline if the bid is withdrawn or modified during the validity period. * **Non-Blacklisting Affidavit:** Submit an original affidavit on **Rs. 1,000/- notarized stamp paper** (d ated **post-tender publication**) declaring no blacklisting or debarment by any Central/State Government , municipal body, or government organization. * **OEM /Bidder Quality Certifications:** OEM/Bidder providing Authorization Letters must hold activ e certificates for: * **ISO 9001:2015** (Quality Management) * **ISO 14001:2015** (Environmental Management) * **ISO 45001:2018** (Occupational Health & Safety) * **ISO 10002:2018** (Customer Satisfaction & Complaints Handling) * **ISO 31000:2018** (Risk Management) * **OEM Annual Turnover:** The OEM must have an average annual turnover of **at least Rs. 50 Lakh** over the last **3 financial years (FY 2022-23, 2023-24, and 2024-25)**, supported by a **CA-certified Turn over Certificate with a valid UDIN**. * **Post-Sale Warranty Deed:** Submit a Warranty & Maintenance Declaration ensuring complete supp ort and supply for a **minimum of 3 years**, executed by the Enterprise/OEM on **minimum Rs. 1,000/- n otarized stamp paper** (**physical submission of original mandatory**). * **Bidder Financial Credentials:** The bidding firm must have an average annual turnover of **at least Rs. 7.5 Lakh** over the last **3 financial years (FY 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26)**. Mandatory upl oads include: * **CA-certified Turnover Certificate with a valid UDIN** * **Income Tax Returns (ITR)** for all **3 years** * **GST 3B return details** for the **last 6 months** * **Make in India (MII):** Attach a **local content declaration** issued by the OEM/Manufacturer under t he Make in India policy. * **ATC Acceptance Stamp:** Upload a signed and stamped Bid ATC Acceptance Declaration executed on **minimum Rs. 1,000/- notarized stamp paper** (dated **post-tender publication**). **Physical submis sion of original is mandatory**. * **Solvency & Liquidation Declaration:** Submit a signed affidavit on **Rs. 500/- non-judicial stamp p aper** declaring no past or current Liquidation, Insolvency, Court Receivership, or similar proceedings. * **Local Support Matrix:** Must have a functional service center/support setup in **Bihar**. Submit vali d **physical address evidence** and a defined **multi-tier Escalation Matrix**. * **Past Execution Experience:** Upload at least **2 previously executed work orders** of similar natur e carried out successfully by the Bidder or its OEM in any State/Central Government Department or Urban Local Body (ULB) within **Bihar**. * **Forged/Incomplete Documents:** Any forged, incomplete, or unreadable document will result in **i mmediate disqualification** without clarification or post-disqualification representation.

--- **5. Dispute Resolution Mechanism (Arbitration)** * **Amicable Resolution Timeline:** Parties must attempt to resolve disputes mutually within **30 days**. * **Administrative Discretion:** If unresolved after **30 days**, the **Buyer's administrative discretion** i n finalizing the bid award prevails. * **Legal Jurisdiction:** Final legal jurisdiction rests exclusively with **Nagar Panchayat Singheshwar (Mad hepura, Bihar)**. * **Mandatory Declaration:** Attach an **unconditional acceptance on official company letterhead**, d uly signed and stamped by the Proprietor, Director, or authorized Partners. .
